title: InteractionBench: Measuring Timing, Task Accuracy, Whisper and Volume, and Grounding in Real-Time Voice Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.02430v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most benchmarks for real-time voice systems focus on one aspect, such as turn-taking, instruction following, paralinguistic control, or conversational memory, each with its own data and set of systems. We present InteractionBench, a benchmark and evaluation harness that measures four dimensions on the same systems from the same recorded user audio: conversational timing, spoken-task accuracy, whisper and volume, and groundedness in conversations of more than twenty turns. The benchmark contains 221 items per system in thirteen scenarios. Before any system runs, we fix the expected floor-control actions for spoken tasks by rule and take the expected answers from scripted dialogues. We score whispering from the audio signal. We evaluate GPT-Live, GPT-Realtime, Gemini Live, Moshi, PersonaPlex, Freeze-Omni, and a turn-based cascade in 1,519 graded runs. Among the six full-duplex systems, timing and spoken-task accuracy are rank-correlated

translated_title: InteractionBench：测量实时语音系统的对话时序、任务准确性、耳语与音量以及接地能力
translated_abstract: 大多数针对实时语音系统的基准测试只关注单一维度，例如话轮转换、指令遵循、副语言控制或对话记忆，且各自使用不同的数据和系统集合。我们提出了 InteractionBench，这是一个基准测试与评估框架，能够在相同系统上基于同一段录制的用户音频测量四个维度：对话时序、口语任务准确性、耳语与音量控制，以及超过二十轮长对话中的接地能力。该基准测试包含十三个场景，每个系统 221 个测试项。在任何系统运行之前，我们通过规则预先确定口语任务的预期话轮控制动作，并从脚本化对话中获取预期答案。我们根据音频信号对耳语进行评分。我们通过 1,519 次评分运行评估了 GPT-Live、GPT-Realtime、Gemini Live、Moshi、PersonaPlex、Freeze-Omni 以及一个基于话轮的级联系统。在六个全双工系统中，时序表现与口语任务准确性呈秩相关（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了统一测量实时语音系统对话时序、口语任务准确性、耳语音量控制和长对话接地能力四个维度的基准测试 InteractionBench，并对 GPT-Live、Gemini Live、Moshi 等七个系统进行了 1,519 次评分运行评估。
en_tdlr: InteractionBench is a unified benchmark that measures conversational timing, spoken-task accuracy, whisper and volume control, and grounding on the same real-time voice systems, evaluating seven systems including GPT-Live, Gemini Live, and Moshi across 1,519 graded runs.
